turns.narration: Blackthorn reached into the satchel at her side and withdrew a folded pair of leather boots, weathered but serviceable. She held them out toward Nicco with a small, assessing glance at his footwear. "These'll hold up better than whatever you're wearing now, if you're planning to walk the district much."

Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
"You'll need them more than me," Nicco says, extending the boots back toward Blackthorn.

The round-built intermediary does not reach for them. She looks at the proffered boots, then at Nicco's feet with a quick assessing glance, her black-bobbed head tilting slightly. "They're not my size," she says flatly. "And I'm not the one trudging around in what—borrowed house shoes? Market sandals?" She makes no move to take them back. Two large men stand behind her, motionless, their presence noted without acknowledgment.

The boots remain between them, unclaimed. Traffic continues across the square at its moderate daytime pace, a few passersby glancing toward the massive wooden entrance of Heartstone, then away. Blackthorn's purple-suited shoulders rise and fall once with what might be impatience held in check. "Keep them, sell them, leave them on the steps," she says. "I don't need the coin, and I've already marked the ledger. They're yours now."
